A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the addition of alpha-cyclodextirn as an excipient to Caverject DCC does not adversely affect the amount of PGI1 delivered by this product, and that the amount is equivalent to that delivered from Caverject S.
Caverject DSC is an equivalent product to Caverject S, but with a longer shelf life.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of alpha-cyclodexrin in Caverject DCC is not expected to alter the amount of active PGE1 available to the patient.
the amount of free alprostadil upon reconstitution and administration of Caverject DSC is not significantly different from that of Caverject S. Tit
